text:
karen: Hey team — quick sync: we need to finalize the customer-facing audit event taxonomy + naming convs before EOD Friday. Current headaches: inconsistent verbs (create vs created), resource path casing (user.id vs user_id), and some KMS/key lifecycle events aren't being surfaced to customers. Can we align on a single pattern? @ali @jonathan @mia please chime in.

ali: +1. from RBAC side: if we expose more KMS events customers will expect to filter by key_id. Do we need a new permission like `audit.read.customer` or can we reuse `audit.read` with scoped resource filters?

jonathan: I'd prefer a single permission `audit.read` and rely on resource scoping in the response. Fewer perms to manage. Also: we should version the event taxonomy (e.g., `audit.v1`) so consumers can depend on stable names.

mia: Agree on versioning. For naming pattern proposal:
``
<domain>.<resource>.<action>.<outcome>
examples:
  auth.user.create.success
  storage.bucket.object.delete.failure
  kms.key.rotate.requested
  kms.key.rotate.success
```
Fields we should standardize in schema: `event_type`, `event_version`, `timestamp`, `actor`, `actor_id`, `resource_type`, `resource_id`, `action`, `outcome`, `request_id`, `audit_id`, `metadata`.

ali: +1 on schema. Important: `actor` should be the display principal (service/user) and `actor_id` the internal id. For customer-facing events we should also include `customer_id` when applicable.

karen: Good call. For KMS specifically: we currently log key material operations internally but don't surface `kms.key.rotate.*` to customers. Product wants rotate + grant/revoke events surfaced for compliance customers.

product-ops: We need grant/revoke and key usage (sign/verify/encrypt/decrypt) counts tied to request_id. Also a way to validate events are from their keyed tenants (signature? HMAC?).

jonathan: For signing, maybe out of scope for first pass. But we can include `signed_by_platform: true` boolean and a `verification_hint` (e.g., URL to public key) in metadata. Customer-signed events can be a later extension.

mia: Validation endpoint idea: POST /platform/audit/validate with payload -> returns `ok|errors` and normalized `event_type` if passed. This helps customers test their mapping.

security-bot: NOTE: current `audit_event` table has columns `type`, `payload`, `created_at`. We'll need to add `event_version`, `resource_type`, `resource_id`, `actor_id` as materialized columns for efficient querying. Filing infra task.

ali: RBAC follow-up: when we add `kms.key.*` events, we must ensure service accounts that rotate keys have `kms.rotate` permission and that audit exposure honors tenancy. I'll make a PR to the RBAC matrix.

karen: UX question — naming synonyms: should we prefer present-tense (`create`) or past-tense (`created`)?

jonathan: prefer present-tense action (create, delete, rotate) + separate `outcome` field (`success|failure|requested`). Cleaner for filtering.

mia: Agree. Also prefer snake_case for schema field names (event_type, resource_id) and dot-delimited lower-case for event_type values.

product-ops: Customers will need a human-readable mapping doc (CSV) and a machine-readable JSON schema (json-schema) per `audit.v1`.

karen: OK action items:
- mia: draft `audit.v1` taxonomy and json-schema (due Tue) -> include KMS events and verify field set.
- ali: update RBAC matrix and PR for `audit.read` scoping + kms permission checks (due Wed).
- jonathan: add `event_version` and materialized columns to audit DB schema proposal + perf notes (due Wed).
- product-ops: prepare customer mapping doc and validation API spec (due Thu).
- security-bot/infra: create infra ticket for column adds and retention policy check (no later than Thu).

karen: Any objections? If not I'll lock this pattern and start a short spec doc. :thumbsup: 

ali: no objections :+1:
jonathan: no objections.
mia: none. I'll start the schema draft now.
product-ops: noted, will share example CSV.
security-bot: ticket created: #INFR-7892

karen: Great — I'll create the `specs/audit-taxonomy/audit.v1.md` doc and tag reviewers. Thanks all.
